statement: The one-variable law x = x*(x*(x*x)) has an anchored model of every size N != 2 and none of size 2; in particular its spectrum contains 4 but not 2, so anchored spectra need not be closed under divisors.
title: The law x = x(x(xx)) has anchored models of every size except 2
